class.name: FMODManager
class.brief_description: Provides the FMOD Studio subsystem to the engine.
class.description: Singleton for accessing FMOD Studio from the engine. Most of these methods mirror what FMOD::Studio::System offers, but a bunch of stuff is automatically initialized on startup for you.

method.name: load_bank
method.description: Loads an FMOD bank from the given path, relative to the project directory. The banks must be loose on the native filesystem (e.g. not in a pack).

method.name: unload_bank
method.description: Unloads an existing FMOD bank from the given path, relative to the project directory. This must be the same bank name passed to load_bank as the string is used for caching.

method.name: is_bank_loaded
method.description: Returns true if the bank with the given name has fully loaded yet. If load_bank was called with non_blocking as false then this function should always return true.

method.name: get_bank_loading_state
method.description: Returns the current load state of the given bank.

method.name: get_loaded_banks
method.description: Gets an array of names of banks that are currently loaded. This includes banks currently in the process of loading if non_blocking was set to true.

method.name: create_instance
method.description: Creates a new event instance from the given FMOD event path.

method.name: get_allocated_memory
method.description: Gets the amount of memory currently allocated by FMOD, in bytes.

method.name: get_max_allocated_memory
method.description: Gets the maximum amount of memory ever allocated by FMOD, in bytes.

method.name: get_num_listeners
method.description: Gets the current number of listeners enabled in FMOD.

method.name: set_num_listeners
method.description: Sets the current number of listeners enabled in FMOD.

constants.constant: The maximum number of FMOD listeners that can exist.
